t.zh: 定义只说 0 和 S x 加上 y 是什么；x 是不知道的数时，x + 0 就算不下去。<level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref>用归纳证出了 x + 0 = x，这一关里它是已知 addZero，用法和别的「对所有」一样：addZero m 证 m + 0 = m。
t.en: The definition only says what 0 and S x plus y are; when x is an unknown number, x + 0 does not work out. <level-ref to="in-zero"></level-ref> proved x + 0 = x by induction, and here it is the given addZero, used like any “for all”: addZero m proves m + 0 = m.

after.zh: 对的、核却算不出来、要靠证明的相等，叫<wiki-ref to="propeq"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: An equality that is true but that the kernel cannot work out, so that it takes a proof, is a <wiki-ref to="propeq"></wiki-ref>.
